biggest_catch: Pay is predominantly in Amazon e-vouchers, not cash - modest per-study amounts at fixed rates.
catches: Payment is predominantly in Amazon e-vouchers, not cash
Rates are fixed: £6.50 for up to 30 min, £13 for up to an hour - no high-paying outliers
Studies take place at LSE in London - in-person availability matters
Payment typically arrives within a week of participation via email, not immediately
Repeated lateness or no-shows get you removed from the Sona database
Unexcused no-show blocks you from all further studies

payout_quote: You will usually be paid £6.50 for any studies that last up to 30 minutes, and £13 for studies that last up to an hour. On occasion, a study may involve an additional financial reward or prize draw, which you will be notified of when the study is advertised. Please note our studies pay predominantly in Amazon e-vouchers, and the form of compensation will be specified on the study posting. Payment is typically received within one week of the date of participation via email.
payout_value_note: £6.50 and £13 converted at 1 GBP = 1.334 USD (mid-market, Sept 22-23 2026) = $8.67-$17.34; paid predominantly in Amazon e-vouchers, not cash.
